title: Reading the Drakken Terraforming Compendium
visual_method: Original programmatic SVG diagrams with animated orbital traces, moving/settling systems, sequential family reveals, progressive chronology and containment-wall emergence; rasterized locally and assembled with FFmpeg crossfades.

source_files.relevant_sections: Catalog counts and classification; corrected timeline; source authority notes

beats.purpose: Introduce the source as a catalog for ecological transformation, not a simple creature list.
beats.claim: The field protocol says Drakken alter the conditions under which life survives.
beats.motion: Stratified world rotates under an orbital scan; labels identify crust and weather.

beats.purpose: Explain the four non-interchangeable categories that total 105 subjects.
beats.claim: 58 documented operational strains + 2 genesis entities + 35 unapproved historical proposals + 10 context plates = 105 subjects.
beats.motion: Category bars reveal in sequence. Exact figures remain fixed during the animation so intermediate frames never imply a false subtotal.

beats.purpose: Show the eight families used to group the 58 operational records.
beats.claim: The PDF names eight functional families; family names are listed without assigning extra traits.
beats.motion: Eight indexed family tiles reveal in two columns around the specimen-index marker.

beats.purpose: Explain the functional lens through a simple world-system diagram.
beats.claim: Functions include crust, atmosphere, biosphere, and civic/institutional change; the compiler frames classification as ecological effect.
beats.motion: Three colored system traces travel from local conditions toward the reframed world; the receiving layers settle into view.

beats.purpose: Give the corrected war chronology and containment aftermath.
beats.claim: Year 121 Ruby Eclipse at Pharos; Year 170 Aureal Gate and first Starsilk use; Hal'Ven heliocide follows and forms the Siege Wall.
beats.motion: Timeline advances through the four dated anchors, then a collapse point appears and the containment wall assembles.

beats.purpose: Close with the evidence and canon boundary.
beats.claim: Historical proposals are not approved canon; images do not establish canonical appearance; source compilation is not approval.
beats.motion: Evidence cards rise into place and the source-summary boundary resolves last.
